name: Hall of Fallen Scales
description: This long chamber is paved with bronze scales set into cracked stone, each one etched with the name of a dead draconic champion. A low red glow pulses beneath the floor like banked embers.
challenges: Some bronze scales tilt underfoot and trigger dart slits hidden between the champion names.
A hanging web curtain conceals movement near the far archway.
clues: The safest path follows the champion names that face east instead of west.
One broken scale shows a faded emerald sword mark beneath the bronze plating.
loot: A small ruby scale worth a handful of gold.

notable_events.event: The Dragonkin carved the names of their fallen champions here so intruders would tread on their memory before facing their wrath.

features.name: Bronze Scale Floor
features.description: A patterned floor of metal scales, many of which hide pressure plates.

features.name: Webbed Archway
features.description: A narrow exit veiled by thick strands of dusty spider silk.

completion.objective: Cross the trapped hall and reach the Emerald Shrine.
signals: the player reaches the far archway
the player enters the emerald shrine
